recorded_by: hand-assembled from the probe's own environment block
why_not_record_run: The probe runs on Colab, which record_run.py cannot wrap. ADR-0004 requires the script to carry its own environment block for exactly this case, and the manifest is assembled here from what it returned.
known_defect: The probe takes no warm-up pass, so the first configuration of each model absorbs model download and CUDA kernel autotuning. In this run that is context 1000, whose 19.75% spread and 13.744 GB peak are warm-up artefacts and are not comparable with the rows below them.
